================================================================================
1. BIOGRAPHICAL & RESEARCH SUMMARY
================================================================================
Name: Steven Kleynenberg (also S.E. Kleynenberg, Steve Kleynenberg)
Base: Delft / The Hague technology corridor, The Netherlands
Primary Roles:
- Founder & Principal AI Architect, Kleynenberg Software Ontwikkeling (KSO): https://kso.kleynenberg.com/
- Publisher & Editor, Kleynenberg Publishers (KP / naaap.io): https://steven.kleynenberg.com/kp/
- Host & Producer, The Kleynenberg Perspective (TKP): https://tkp.kleynenberg.com/

Key Intellectual Property & Publications (1990–2026):
- Co-author of foundational neural network compiler and parallel hardware papers on MetaNet and BSP400 (INNC 1990 Paris, IJCNN 1991 Seattle, ICANN 1991 Espoo).
- Co-inventor of PCT International Patent Application WO 2014/003543 A1 (PCT/NL2012/050463): automated linguistic sequence filtering and patent search (https://patents.google.com/patent/WO2014003543A1/en).
- Co-author of ESOCC 2015 research paper on the MEDUSA acute stroke clinical workflow system (ITEA 2 10004).
- Track record across European public-private innovation consortia: LORE (EU FP5 IST-1999-12645), EDAFMIS (ITEA 2 07011), MEDUSA (ITEA 2 10004), Medolution (ITEA 3 14003), and PARTNER (ITEA 3 16017).
